Subject: POC / Trial plan & deployment mode - Zenith Analytics (post-call recap)

Hi Olivia / Samir —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Primary goal: integrate an LLM-powered assistant into your customer support triage flow to handle intent classification and automated draft responses.
- Traffic profile: ~1.2M monthly messages, peak bursts during EMEA morning + US afternoon.
- Latency requirement: 300–500ms p50 for classification, acceptable 800ms p95 for generation.
- Data/security constraints: customer PII must not be persisted in a multi-tenant environment; SOC 2 evidence and VPC option required for production.
- Stakeholders: Olivia (product), Samir (security/infra), Aaron Lee (platform).

Deployment modes we discussed: Hosted API for quick test, Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput, and Private VPC for full isolation. From our call it sounds like you want to validate Dedicated capacity for the PoC, and confirm that migration to Private VPC is possible for production if procurement requires.

Next steps / proposed PoC plan (high-level):
1) 2-week sandbox (hosted) to smoke test integration and success criteria
2) 4-week Dedicated-capacity PoC (real traffic replay + safety/latency tests)
3) Security review and readiness for Private VPC if procurement needs it

I'll attach a short PoC plan and a cost estimate for Dedicated capacity. Can you confirm stakeholders and rough dates for procurement sync?

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan-zenith.pdf, redwood-cost-estimate-zenith.xlsx

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30m kickoff if you want to lock dates.

Best,
Ben Carter

Ben —

Appreciate the recap. Correct on everything — high level matches our notes. A few clarifications and asks from our side:

1) Security: Samir needs a SOC 2 evidence pack and a checklist of what would be available in Dedicated vs Private VPC (esp. network isolation, KMS integration, audit logs).
2) Data handling: we need confirmation that PII can be redacted before logging and that you can disable model logging on Dedicated.
3) Timeline: procurement prefers a 6–8 week window to approve Dedicated capacity spend; if the PoC proves objectives, procurement will push Private VPC for prod.
4) Success criteria for PoC: 1) 90% classification accuracy on our labeled set, 2) p95 latency <= 900ms under representative load, 3) security checklist items approved by Samir.

We'd like to run the sandbox hosted test this week (endpoints + sample data), then move to Dedicated for the main PoC in mid-April. Stakeholders who should be on the kickoff: Aaron Lee (platform), Samir (security), myself, and your Solutions Engineer.

Can you confirm sample data upload method (S3 link or secure upload?), and share the SOC 2 / Dedicated vs VPC feature matrix?

Thanks,
Olivia
Head of Product | Zenith Analytics
olivia.turner@zenithanalytics.com

Hi Olivia / Samir —

Great — thanks for the specificity, that's exactly the criteria we like to validate. Quick answers and an updated plan attached: redwood-poc-plan-zenith.pdf (detailed milestones) and redwood-cost-estimate-zenith.xlsx.

Security / compliance: I'll loop Marissa (cc'd) to coordinate the SOC 2 pack and the Dedicated vs Private VPC feature matrix. Short answers:
- SOC 2: we will provide the SOC 2 Type II report and our standard security questionnaire responses.
- Dedicated: supports KMS integration, per-customer audit logs, and the ability to disable model logging; network access is via IP allowlist and private peering options for tighter isolation.
- Private VPC: full customer VPC with private control plane and on-prem options available for stricter regulatory controls.

Data upload: S3 pre-signed URL is easiest for the sandbox — we'll provide a secure bucket with short TTL. For Dedicated/Private, we can support secure SFTP or direct peering to your S3 depending on your procurement preferences.

Updated PoC timeline (proposal):
- Week 0 (this week): sandbox hosted test + sample data ingestion (1–2 days)
- Weeks 1–4 (mid-April): Dedicated PoC with traffic replay, latency testing, and security validation
- Week 5: evaluation & decision to plan Private VPC for prod (if procurement approves)

Can we lock a 45-minute kickoff on Thursday 25 Mar at 10:00am PT with Aaron / Samir / Marissa (solutions/security) + our Solutions Engineer? If that time doesn't work, propose alternatives.

Thanks — I'll also attach the NDA we use for initial data access (nda_zenith.pdf) in case procurement needs it signed before sample uploads.

Best,
Ben
